name: column overpressure
consequence: pressure rises to the trip; relief lifts, possible flange leaks

name: reboiler dry-out
consequence: tube overheating and damage when level falls below the trip

name: instrument fault or spurious reading
consequence: acting on a wrong reading; masked hazard or spurious intervention

cause: condenser cooling water loss (pump trip, strainer blockage)
effect: vapor condensation drops; PT-301 rises steadily while duty is unchanged

cause: reflux pump degradation or FC-601 valve restriction
effect: liquid return drops; LT-401 falls while reboiler duty keeps boiling

cause: cooling water header pressure dips when the neighboring unit starts its pumps
effect: FT-501 sags ~10% for a minute or two and recovers on its own; not a true cooling loss

reason: defeating the pressure trip removes the last independent protection layer
adds vapor generation while condensation is already insufficient

plan: restore duty to the previous value once PT-301 is back below alarm and cooling is confirmed
close the vent once PT-301 is below 190 kPa; file the emissions report within 24 h
restart per SOP-RESTART after the cause is cleared; expect ~6 h production loss
